recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-6233 unless a future work group decision creates a new, explicitly specified AuditEvent network search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-6233 was a Published Security WG change request for DSTU1. It reported that AuditEvent.participant.network.identifier was misleading because the element was a string rather than Identifier, and it asked to rename it to address; the accepted resolution was AuditEvent.participant.network.identifier --> address, with search not treated as token.
initial_application: The requested rename appears to have been applied in git commit 8e1a48066d70501f76de61f4511ec19b48da2df2, whose message lists item 6233 and whose AuditEvent spreadsheet and examples rename participant.network.identifier to participant.network.address.
additional_context: AuditEvent remains active in source/fhir.ini. Later source refactoring renamed participant to agent and then replaced the agent.network backbone, including address/type children, with AuditEvent.agent.network[x]. fhir.ini conversion notes map old AuditEvent.agent.network.address/type to network[x]. Current community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml defines AuditEvent.agent.network[x] as Reference(Endpoint), uri, or string; repository searches found no participant.network.identifier or agent.network.identifier element; and source/auditevent/bundle-AuditEvent-search-params.xml contains no AuditEvent network/address search parameter.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification Security WG issue accepted renaming AuditEvent.participant.network.identifier to address and noted the value should not have token search semantics.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final requested correction for the AuditEvent network element and search behavior.

evidence_items.summary: Commit 'Updates for items 6233, 6269, 7431, 7564, 7566, 8123, and 8589' renamed AuditEvent.participant.network.identifier to AuditEvent.participant.network.address in the AuditEvent spreadsheet and examples.
evidence_items.learned: The accepted FHIR-6233 rename was historically applied in source.

evidence_items.summary: Current AuditEvent source defines AuditEvent.agent.network[x] as Reference(Endpoint), uri, or string.
evidence_items.learned: The old identifier-named child no longer exists in the current authoritative resource definition.

evidence_items.command: perl -0ne 'while (/<SearchParameter>.*?<id value="([^"]+)".*?<code value="([^"]+)".*?<type value="([^"]+)"/sg) { print "$1\t$2\t$3\n" }' source/auditevent/bundle-AuditEvent-search-params.xml; rg -n 'participant\.network\.identifier|agent\.network\.identifier|AuditEvent-network|<code value="network"' source
evidence_items.summary: The current AuditEvent search parameter bundle contains no network/address search parameter, and repository search found no old network identifier element or AuditEvent-network search parameter.
evidence_items.learned: There is no remaining token search issue for the old string network address value.

evidence_items.summary: source/fhir.ini lists auditevent as an active resource and maps old AuditEvent.agent.network.address/type to network[x].
evidence_items.learned: The inspected AuditEvent files are in current build scope and the old address/type lineage is handled by conversion metadata.
